verdict.rationale: OCI documents typical HTTPS REST APIs with a formal 12-month deprecation-notice policy. Official SDKs and a CLI with Console parity and token-based auth wrap that API, so an AI-native user has a well-documented programmatic surface to drive the product. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving OCI via its API.
